actual_scope: Can the production multicold clifford_exact.py used by scripts/verify_cold617_interface.py adopt the proved exact gate-table zero_state from research/clifford-state-performance/ so the shipped helper-interface path is faster while every receipt field stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling leave-alone production rewrites and remaining proved opt-in adapters. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point, ternary, parity-side, R420 rref/geometry/mutants, frameopt.close, leech_minor, verify_factor, sparse-fusion, joint-dual replay, quadratic-affine for #1076, data_corners #2320, e8-bit-r420 MANIFEST-only edits) were skipped. Promoting emitted-local integer rows into research/complex-k492-owner-repair/code/hpe_audit_local.py was rejected: that path is byte-bound to SELECTED-SOURCE.json via complex-sw4-frame8/local/hpe_audit_local.py across many VERIFY packages. The clifford-state opt-in adapter already proved ~2.8× on the helper-interface fixture; production multicold clifford_exact.py still used the pairwise per-amplitude evaluator. This session wires that equivalent evaluator into the shipped source and demotes/refreshes dependent pins.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: the cold617 helper-interface check is on the selected replay surface. A faster identical receipt does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production clifford_exact.py change with frozen baseline, identical helper-interface receipts, corruption controls, pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
evidence: PASS_CLIFFORD_STATE_PRODUCTION via research/clifford-state-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE; PASS_IDENTICAL_CLIFFORD_STATE_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via pinned-CPU benchmark.py --rounds 5 (median 1.202→0.382 s, 3.148×); research/clifford-state-performance demotes the pairwise-era working-source pin; research/clifford-reciprocal-basis-obstruction demotes clifford_exact to provenance and drops it from VERIFY inputs.
